summary: First E2E frontend web test for 'WENDEL CORTES' barbershop app (Expo web). Tested WebFrame wrapper on desktop (1366x800) and mobile (390x844). All flows pass: browser title 'Wendel Cortes — Barbearia' is set; desktop shows centered 520px column with WENDEL/CORTES side branding + 'AGENDAMENTOS · FILA · CLIENTE MENSAL' tagline; mobile is full-width with no side branding. Client login (carlos@test.com), navigation across all 5 tabs (Início, Agendar, Fila, Mensal, Perfil) works with real data; end-to-end booking flow succeeds (Corte → 2026-10-07 → 15:30 → PIX → Confirmar): success text 'Agendamento confirmado!' shows, wa.me link opens in new tab, and the booking appears in Perfil > Próximos Atendimentos. Fila (client) shows the user already at position 1º with queue list. Admin login (admin@wendelcortes.com) lands on Dashboard with live metrics (Faturamento R$ 45.00, 3 agendamentos, 4 na fila, 4 mensalistas ativos); admin tabs Agenda, Fila, Mensalistas, Mais all render populated data. Zero JS runtime errors captured in any flow.
critical_code_review_comments: web-frame.tsx cleanly gates on Platform.OS==='web' && width>=768; native path is a pure pass-through — good, no regression risk for iOS/Android builds.
Sets document.title and body backgroundColor in a useEffect guarded by typeof document !== 'undefined' — safe for SSR/native.
FRAME_MAX_WIDTH=520 gives comfortable mobile-like column on desktop; side branding column uses flex:1 with paddingRight so it scales on wider screens (verified at 1366px).
No hardcoded URLs; frontend uses EXPO_BACKEND_URL correctly (login/agendar/fila/dashboard all round-trip through /api).
All key interactive elements expose data-testid (login-*, svc-*, date-*, slot-*, pay-*, confirm-btn, qa-*) — excellent testability.
Minor cosmetic: two identical 'WENDEL CORTES' brand blocks (side + inside frame) on the login screen at desktop, which is intentional but slightly redundant visually — no functional issue.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed users (Carlos, João, Rafael, Marcos, Lucas) and admin. Booking flow created one extra appointment for Carlos on 2026-10-07 15:30 (PIX, pending payment), visible in Perfil.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testIDs: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button. Client quick-actions: qa-agendar/qa-fila/qa-mensal/qa-perfil. Agendar screen testIDs: svc-<Service>, date-YYYY-MM-DD, slot-HH:MM, pay-pix|cartao|dinheiro|mensal, confirm-btn. Admin tabs have no testIDs — use page.get_by_text('Agenda'|'Fila'|'Mensalistas'|'Mais'|'Dashboard').last with force=True. Confirm booking opens wa.me in a popup (api.whatsapp.com) — attach page.context.on('page', ...) if you want to capture it. Desktop breakpoint is 768px; mobile viewport (390x844) hides side branding. Seeded queue is already populated with 4 clients (Carlos at position 1) so 'Sair da fila' button is what a joined client sees.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Feature works end-to-end on both desktop web and mobile web viewports.
